meta.project: Matrix F4 Ultimate - SmartTrade / MEXC Automation Dashboard

product_overview: A web dashboard that lets traders configure, execute and monitor automated smart trades (market/limit, TP/SL, trailing) integrated with MEXC, powered by the Matrix v3 AI engine and PostgreSQL-backed persistence.
core_goals: Enable users to create and submit advanced smart trades (TP/SL, trailing, wick protection) through a simple UI.
Execute and monitor trades reliably via MEXC integration with real-time status and P&L updates.
Provide AI-driven trade signals and regime analysis to guide trade permissioning and risk thresholds.
Persist user configurations, trade history and system state in a unified database for audit and recovery.
Expose clear error handling and recovery flows (insufficient funds, connectivity, validation) to minimize accidental losses.

features.name: Smart Trade UI
features.description: Front-end interface for building and submitting smart trades with fields for symbol, order type, quantity, TP/SL, trailing and safety options.
user_flows: Navigate to /smart-trade -> Select symbol -> Choose order type (Market or Limit) -> Enter quantity -> Set Take Profit value -> Set Stop Loss value -> Toggle Trailing Take Profit if desired -> Toggle Trailing Stop Loss if desired -> Click Submit Smart Trade -> See confirmation modal with trade summary -> Click Confirm -> See success toast and trade listed on /trades/active

Navigate to /smart-trade -> Leave required fields empty -> Click Submit Smart Trade -> See inline validation errors for missing fields -> Fill missing fields with invalid values (e.g., TP <= entry) -> Click Submit Smart Trade -> See validation error message explaining the constraint -> Correct values -> Click Submit Smart Trade -> Confirm -> See success toast

features.name: Smart Trade Execution
features.description: Backend flow that receives UI submissions, validates strategy rules, persists the trade, and places orders on MEXC (or test mode) using order types and trailing logic.
user_flows: Navigate to /smart-trade -> Fill trade form and click Submit Smart Trade -> System POSTs to /api/smart-trade/submit -> System validates business rules and writes trade to DB -> System sends order request to /api/mexc/order -> Receive order accepted response -> See trade created with status "pending" on /trades/active -> See order status update to "filled" with entry price on /trades/:id

Navigate to /smart-trade -> Fill trade form exceeding available balance -> Click Submit Smart Trade -> System POSTs to /api/smart-trade/submit -> MEXC returns error 'insufficient funds' -> See error notification on UI stating 'Insufficient funds' -> User reduces quantity and resubmits -> System succeeds

features.name: Smart Trade Monitoring
features.description: Continuous background monitoring service that tracks active trades for TP/SL hits, trailing adjustments, wick protection, move-to-breakeven and records events to trade history.
user_flows: Navigate to /trades/active -> See list of active trades with real-time PNL -> System background process polls /api/mexc/order/status and market data -> System detects TP reached -> System executes closing order -> See trade moved to history with realized PNL and status "closed" on /trades/:id

Navigate to /trades/active -> See trade status 'watching' -> System background process detects sharp wick triggering stop timeout -> System applies Stop Loss Timeout (wick protection) and does not immediately close -> See status update 'wick-protected' and SL moved to recovery window -> If price recovers, see SL restored; if not, see SL executed and trade closed

features.name: Active Trades Dashboard
features.description: Dashboard listing current open smart trades with PNL, status, quick actions (cancel, move to breakeven, edit trailing), and drill-in trade detail view.
user_flows: Navigate to /trades/active -> See table of open trades with columns (symbol, entry, TP, SL, PNL, status) -> Click a trade row -> See trade detail at /trades/:id with full execution and event log -> Click 'Move to Breakeven' -> See confirmation -> See stop loss updated to entry price and confirmation toast

Navigate to /trades/active -> Select an open trade -> Click 'Cancel Trade' -> System attempts cancel via /api/mexc/order/cancel -> MEXC returns cancellation error -> See error toast 'Cancellation failed' and a retry button -> Click retry -> See eventual cancellation success or persistent failure message

features.name: MEXC Exchange Integration
features.description: Connector that signs and sends orders to MEXC V3 API, queries order status and handles errors/edge cases (auth failure, rate limits, rejections).
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/api -> Click Connect MEXC -> Enter API key and secret -> Click Save -> System sends test request to /api/mexc/test -> Receive success -> See 'Connected' status on /settings/api and ability to place live orders

Navigate to /settings/api -> Enter invalid or revoked keys -> Click Save -> System sends test request to /api/mexc/test -> Receive authentication error -> See error 'API authentication failed' and instructions to re-generate keys -> User corrects keys and retries

features.name: Matrix v3 AI Engine
features.description: AI-driven engine providing trend prediction, market regime classification and an AI confidence score used to gate or inform trade decisions (score 0-100).
user_flows: Navigate to /smart-trade -> Select symbol -> System queries Matrix v3 engine for AI Score -> See AI Score displayed next to symbol (e.g., 72) -> If score >= configured threshold (65) see 'Trade Recommended' indicator -> User proceeds to submit trade

Navigate to /smart-trade -> Select symbol -> System queries Matrix v3 engine -> See AI Score below threshold (e.g., 35) -> UI displays warning 'AI score below allowed threshold' and disables direct submit -> User toggles manual override -> See explicit confirmation modal explaining risk -> If user confirms override, allow submission; otherwise abort

features.name: Database Abstraction & Persistence
features.description: Unified DB layer that persists trades, configs, price history and system snapshots; exposes read/write endpoints used by the UI and background monitors.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Update default trade settings (default TP%, default SL%) -> Click Save -> System writes settings to PostgreSQL via DB abstraction -> See success toast 'Settings saved' and values reflected in UI

Attempt to save settings while DB is unavailable -> Click Save -> System returns error from DB abstraction -> See error banner 'Unable to save settings, try again' -> User clicks Retry -> System eventually succeeds or shows support contact info
